title: Catalog router configuration
description: The process environment the edge reads: the session signing key and the identity half of the GitHub App.

HUB_SESSION_SECRET.description: Secret. Signs the session cookie; sessions are in memory, so there is nothing to fall back to when it is unset.

GITHUB_APP_CLIENT_ID.description: Public half of the user-to-server sign-in flow. Not required: unset, the GitHub path is unavailable and the local mount works.

GITHUB_APP_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Secret. Identity flow only and grants no repository access, which is not a reason to let it be read back out of git.
